key: bio:v3:Titan Company Ltd:Retirement:Noel N. Tata retires as Non-Executive Director and Vice-Chairman effective 12 November 2026.

people.name: Noel N. Tata
background: Chairman of Tata Trusts and vice‑chairman of Titan Company
Previously managing director of Tata International and director of Titan Industries
Bachelor’s degree from University of Sussex and International Executive Programme at INSEAD

value.why_it_matters: His departure creates a vacancy on Titan’s board, prompting a new appointment that could affect board composition and governance continuity.
